identity.title: Knowledge Entropy Decay during Language Model Pretraining Hinders New Knowledge Acquisition

problem.claim: The work examines how models’ integration of parametric knowledge changes during pretraining and affects knowledge acquisition and forgetting.

contributions.claim: Introduces knowledge entropy, a measure of the range of memory sources engaged by a model.
Reports that knowledge entropy consistently declines as pretraining advances and is associated with reduced knowledge acquisition and retention.
Reports that increasing activity from inactive memory sources improves knowledge acquisition and retention.

stated_novelty.claim: The authors introduce the concept of knowledge entropy to characterize the breadth of memory sources used by a model.

author_reported_evidence.claim: The authors report a consistent decline in knowledge entropy throughout pretraining.
The authors report that lower knowledge entropy is closely associated with reduced ability to acquire and retain knowledge.
The authors report improved acquisition and retention when inactive memory sources are made more active.

narrative_sequence.summary: Investigates the evolution and consequences of models’ broad integration of parametric knowledge during pretraining.
Defines knowledge entropy as the range of memory sources engaged, distinguishing broad use from reliance on specific sources.
Reports that knowledge entropy declines consistently as pretraining progresses.
Links declining entropy to weaker acquisition and retention, then reports gains when inactive memory sources become more active.

source_observation.claim: The abstract pairs a proposed summary measure of memory-source breadth with a targeted manipulation of inactive sources and reports aligned changes in knowledge acquisition and retention.

lessons.interpretation: This provides a compact claim–evidence pattern connecting a measurable internal property to an outcome and an intervention.
lessons.application: For a related mechanism claim, define a quantitative proxy, track it over the relevant process, and test whether changing the proxy corresponds to the predicted outcome.
lessons.exception: This pattern is unsuitable when the proxy lacks a defensible operational definition or cannot be manipulated independently of major confounds.

unknowns: The abstract does not specify how knowledge entropy or memory-source activity is measured.
Model scales, datasets, training conditions, effect sizes, and comparison baselines are not reported.
The abstract does not establish whether the reported associations are causal beyond the stated intervention result.
